details:
1. Prepare three accounts (let's call them “A”, “B”, and “C”, respectively). (Let them be “A”, “B”, and “C” respectively.)

2. Block B with A. 

3. select “Switch Account” on the VRChat you were logged in to with C, and then log in again with A. In the same way, select “Switch Account” in the VRChat where you were logged in with A, and then log in again with C.

4. At this time, the user that C is blocking will appear in the “Blocking” list in the VRChat where you are logged in with A, and the user that A is blocking will appear in the “Blocking” list in the VRChat where you are logged in with C.

5. Here is the key: If A, B, and C enter the same instance, A and B will recognize each other, even though A should have blocked B. From C's point of view, it looks like they are blocking B on the “Blocked” list, but they are able to recognize each other normally.

6. Restart VRChat and it will return to normal.

In other words, even if you think you are blocking someone, this feature may cause interference from the person you blocked.

We seek immediate improvement.
title: Switching accounts without exiting VRChat causes a glitch in the list of users I have blocked.
